restaurant.name: Afrinaija Pots
restaurant.location: House 18 Kimiroonko close to Bank Kigali, KG 40 St, Kigali

menu_highlights.name: Vegetable Soup (Efo Riro)
menu_highlights.description: A rich, nutrient-dense medley of fresh spinach, locust beans, and premium proteins.

menu_highlights.name: Egusi & Gari
menu_highlights.description: Ground melon seeds steamed with traditional spices and palm oil. Served with smooth Gari.

menu_highlights.name: Signature Jollof Rice & Beans
menu_highlights.description: Long-grain rice infused with a smoky tomato-pepper base, paired with honey beans.

menu_highlights.name: Jollof Rice Spaghetti
menu_highlights.description: Al dente pasta tossed in our signature spicy Jollof sauce. A modern, vibrant twist.

testimonials.name: David M.
testimonials.text: I’ve visited many spots in Kigali, but the hospitality here is unmatched. The staff is professional and they make you feel like royalty.

testimonials.name: Chiamaka A.
testimonials.text: As a Nigerian in Kigali, I was searching for the right spice. The Egusi here is exactly how my grandmother makes it. Phenomenal!

testimonials.name: Sonia U.
testimonials.text: The presentation was stunning—a work of art. But the taste? Even better. They put a lot of heart into the details.
